rule: Curator decisions on sourcing-pass candidates. The candidates_*.json files stay as the sourcing passes wrote them; these entries are merged over them by build_visual_bank.py. A hold stops an asset counting towards any need; a note adds a concern without a hold.

holds.BIO-6116-ORG-042: looks like a scan of printed textbook artwork uploaded under a CC BY-SA claim; the uploader may not hold the rights. Do not use unless the original artwork's licence is traced
holds.BIO-6116-HUM-023: Commons metadata names no creator, so the attribution a CC licence requires cannot be written yet; confirm on the file page
holds.BIO-6116-ROOT-001: Defective scale label, beyond-syllabus labels and obscured starch-grain leader in variants. No counting towards any need until a corrected syllabus-limited variant and teacher review exist. Original preserved; no measurement use.
holds.BIO-6116-STEM-001: Uncertain phloem placement and vascular-bundle extent in variants. Hold all uses pending teacher validation and appropriate bundle indication; original remains a sourcing candidate only.
holds.BIO-6116-BLOOD-001: Incomplete for the mapped full blood-cell requirement (no demonstrated lymphocyte); uncertain white-cell/platelet label placements. Hold pending exact-use teacher review and a separate lymphocyte field.
holds.BIO-6116-HUM-021: Second white-cell identity uncertain. Hold pending a reviewed exact-use crop/label restriction; no cell-type key inferred from file title.
holds.BIO-6116-HUM-026: Monocyte versus band-neutrophil identity unresolved. Hold pending expert confirmation of the exact intended phagocyte use.
holds.BIO-6116-GRAPH-HUMANPOP-001: Approximate published values lack completed source/value verification. No counting towards graph needs before verification.

notes.BIO-6116-HUM-021: One cell is clearly a lymphocyte; label only that one until the second is identified.
notes.BIO-6116-HUM-026: Filed as a monocyte but may be a band neutrophil. Either way it is a phagocyte, which is the NSSCO term; do not label it 'monocyte'.
notes.BIO-6116-ORG-060: Pine is a gymnosperm: its cones are not flowers. Use it only to show wind dispersal of pollen, with that stated.
notes.BIO-6116-ORG-080: Shows carbon stores and fluxes as numbers, not process names; a teaching variant must add photosynthesis, respiration and combustion, or another diagram is needed.
